rationale: All four independently governed child components are now COMPLETED and re-verified on main: deterministic asset inventory, read-only evaluation, bounded local execution, and proposal-only outcome learning. The parent can now advance as a staged repository-local integration program, provided direct parent implementation remains decomposed into a read-only orchestrator, an append-only human review ledger, and a promotion application preview. No external execution, adjacent-repository write, autonomous approval, or Skill mutation authority is granted by this assessment.

queries: append-only human review ledger separation of duties
promotion application preview rollback draft pull request

assets.notes: Provides deterministic cross-repository ownership, provenance, privacy boundaries, and pinned asset references.
Provides read-only selection, evaluation, recommendation, checkpoint, and current-gate verification.
Provides bounded local execution planning, authorization fingerprints, WIP enforcement, budgets, stop rules, checkpoints, and reconstruction.
Provides privacy-safe governed outcome bundles and exact evidence integrity verification.
Provides deterministic baseline/candidate comparison, immutable thresholds, and rollback snapshot verification.
Provides deterministic proposal-only learning records, exact evidence provenance, risk separation, pending human review, and fail-closed authority boundaries.
Provides the current inspected promotion-review contract as reference only; it grants no write or application authority.

gaps: No parent integration record currently binds the four child fingerprints into one reconstructable run.
The current human review record is intentionally PENDING and there is no append-only final-decision ledger.
No application-preview contract exists for displaying an adjacent-repository change without writing it.
All committed outcomes remain SIMULATED_ONLY; a later real-run pilot must be separately approved and cannot be fabricated.

risks: A parent orchestrator could accidentally become a new execution authority instead of a read-only coordinator.
A human approval record could be confused with Skill application authority.
A preview feature could drift into adjacent-repository mutation or direct publication.
Private prompts, credentials, customer data, provider payloads, or private repository bodies could enter integrated records.
Synthetic evidence could be overgeneralized before a real-run pilot exists.
